braid.name: loop-twice
braid.description: A route drives around a block and then along the block's first side again, the same way (like Tel Aviv's 24-0 around a roundabout); a straight route crosses the block.
braid.expect: Route A is one line: in from the west, around the block, along its south side a second time in the same slot, then out to the east. Route B crosses the block north to south on its own.
